body:
## Problem

Model Breakdown shows all tools even after the user focuses the chart on a tool source such as OpenCode or Codex CLI. This makes cross-tool comparisons possible, but it is confusing when the active chart scope and the table scope differ.

Concrete example:

- Click the Codex CLI source card/name.
- Daily Tokens by Model focuses on Codex CLI.
- Model Breakdown still shows OpenCode rows above Codex rows because it is unfiltered.

Users need an explicit way to scope Model Breakdown by tool.

## Proposed solution

Add a tool filter control directly above Model Breakdown:

- All tools
- OpenCode
- Codex CLI
- Hermes, once implemented

The table should apply the selected tool scope and show the active scope in visible copy.

## Acceptance criteria

- Model Breakdown has an explicit tool filter UI.
- Selecting Codex CLI shows only Codex model rows.
- Selecting OpenCode shows only OpenCode model rows.
- Selecting All restores all model rows.
- Empty state says which tool produced no rows.
- The table subtitle or filter state makes clear whether it is scoped independently or shared with chart scope.
- Browser smoke verifies the filter, rows, empty state, and no console errors.

## Notes

This can be implemented as a smaller follow-up before a larger combined chart/table filtering redesign.

Part of #9.
title: Filter Model Breakdown by tool source
